description: This file defines the VardefManager class responsible for managing variable definitions (vardefs) within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for creating, loading, updating, cleaning, caching, and clearing vardefs for modules and objects, as well as handling relationships and templates. The class facilitates dynamic management of module field definitions and their caching mechanisms.

classes.name: VardefManager
classes.description: A static class that manages the creation, loading, caching, and clearing of vardefs (variable definitions) for modules in SuiteCRM. It supports template application, relationship management, and system-wide configuration adjustments.

methods.name: createVardef
methods.description: Loads vardefs for a module using specified templates, initializes default language files, and loads custom vardefs if disabled modules are configured.

methods.name: setCustomAllowedForModule
methods.description: Enables or disables custom vardef loading for a specific module.

methods.name: addTemplate
methods.description: Adds a template to a module's vardefs, merging fields, relationships, and indices from template files.

methods.name: cleanVardefs
methods.description: Removes invalid or incomplete field definitions from vardefs.

methods.name: saveCache
methods.description: Serializes and caches vardefs for a module object to a file and in memory cache.

methods.name: clearVardef
methods.description: Clears cached vardefs for a specific module and object, or for all modules.

methods.name: _clearCache
methods.description: Internal method to delete the cached vardef file and clear cache for a specific module and object.

methods.name: refreshVardefs
methods.description: Reloads vardefs from available files and caches them, supporting additional search paths and custom cache features.

methods.name: getLinkFieldsForModule
methods.description: Retrieves link-type fields for a module, caching the result for efficiency.

methods.name: getLinkFieldForRelationship
methods.description: Gets the link field related to a specific relationship in a module, with caching.

methods.name: applyGlobalAccountRequirements
methods.description: Adjusts vardef definitions to enforce global account relationship requirements based on configuration.

methods.name: loadVardef
methods.description: Loads vardefs for a given module and object from cache or filesystem, optionally forcing a refresh.
